about: The file big.txt in this folder holds about 41,000 characters. Save it as a note with the notes MCP server's save_note tool, title "big", body the whole text of big.txt. The arguments are large, so pass them through a file as your use_tool instructions describe for large MCP arguments: write the complete invocation JSON to a file under /tmp and call use_tool with only its file. Then reply with what the tool answered. A large MCP call passed through a file: the model writes the call to a JSON file and calls use_tool with only that file, which Grok reads, reporting the call it ran inline.
